Nutrition Data Corrections

To report a specific value that doesn’t match the restaurant’s official nutrition information, please use our nutrition data error form and include the restaurant, the item, the value you saw and, if possible, a link to the official source. Every report is checked against the official source before anything changes. You can also read how we source and check nutrition data.

Website Feedback

If a calculator, table or page isn’t working as expected, email us with the page address, the device and browser you used, and what happened.

Privacy Questions

For questions about how this site handles information, see our privacy policy, or email us with “Privacy” in the subject line.
